newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Banco Latino December sale back on track.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Banco Latino December sale back on track.

text.p: The slated December auction of Venezuelan commercial bank Arfinan will go ahead on schedule -- but at a new base price, outgoing bank president Rolando Salcedo said.
"The privatisation process continues and will comply with the timetable," Salcedo told a press conference.

Earlier Monday company sources told Reuters the auction had been postponed until next year following a decision by national state deposits guarantee fund, Fogade, and that Salcedo had resigned because of that decision.

Salcedo did not comment on his resignation, announced Friday, and merely said Fogade had ordered a new valuation of the bank, which was created out of the financial restructuring of state- owned Banco Latino.
Arfinan's base price had previously been set at 22 billion bolivars ($47 million).
-- Ana Isabel Martinez and Oscar Galvis, Caracas newsroom, 582 505 2600
